title: FigmaTrace: Capturing Creative Nuances in Human Figma Design Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2608.21460v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision Language Models have recently shown improvements in several objective and verifiable domains such as object detection but continue to underperform on subjective and creative design tasks. A major contributor to this performance gap is the lack of high quality human workflow data that captures a diverse set of preferences and decisions that make human experts good at design tasks. In this work, we first define a unique, expert curated taxonomy of design skills and best practices which we further expand into a set of 126 open ended, subjective, long horizon tasks. Built on top of this and expert solutions, our dataset FigmaTrace contains over 200 hours of human captured video data converted into 3469 design trajectories using a novel design phase-based method. We use our dataset to train four models and show that training on FigmaTrace leads to a performance improvement comparable to frontier closed models such as \textsc{Claude-O

translated_title: FigmaTrace：捕捉人类Figma设计工作流中的创意细微之处
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型近年来在目标检测等客观且可验证的领域表现出改进，但在主观和创造性设计任务上仍表现不佳。造成这一性能差距的主要原因是缺乏高质量的人类工作流数据，这些数据能够捕捉使人类专家擅长设计任务的多样化偏好和决策。在这项工作中，我们首先定义了一个独特且由专家策划的设计技能和最佳实践分类体系，并进一步将其扩展为一组126个开放式、主观且长期的任务。基于此及专家解决方案，我们的数据集FigmaTrace包含超过200小时的人类录制视频数据，通过一种新颖的基于设计阶段的方法转化为3469条设计轨迹。我们使用该数据集训练了四个模型，并表明在FigmaTrace上训练带来的性能提升可与Claude-O等前沿封闭模型相媲美。
tldr: 本文提出了FigmaTrace数据集，通过专家策划的设计技能分类和基于设计阶段的新方法，将200多小时的人类设计视频转化为3469条轨迹，有效提升了视觉语言模型在创造性设计任务上的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces FigmaTrace, a dataset that converts over 200 hours of human design videos into 3469 trajectories via a novel phase-based method and expert-curated taxonomy, significantly improving vision language model performance on creative design tasks.
